name: dsh-wechat-box
description: 自建微信桥接插件 for DeepSeek Harness: 每个对话一个开关（开=双向），微信侧发任意消息得到编号会话列表、回数字即切换，提问与审批自动推到微信并可在微信作答。WeChat iLink transport ported from @xmanrui/dsh-im (MIT).

scripts.test: node lib/test-manifest.mjs && node router/test.mjs && node transport/test.mjs && node harness/test.mjs && node harness/test-questions.mjs && node harness/test-approvals.mjs && node lib/test.mjs && node lib/test-client.mjs && node lib/test-integration.mjs && node lib/test-e2e.mjs
